versions.content: Default value for EndToEndDescription . dataIdNib- bleOffset If EndToEndDescription . dataIdMode is set to the value 3 and at the same time EndToEndDescription . category is set to the value PRO- FILE_01 and EndToEndDescription . dataIdNibbleOffset is not speci- fied, then the default value of 12 (bits) shall be assumed for the attribute End- ToEndDescription . dataIdNibbleOffset .
